name: Wnt / β-catenin
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "A developmental pathway hijacked by colorectal cancer. Normally a destruction complex keeps β-catenin low; losing APC lets it flood the nucleus and drive growth genes."
fields.after: "Wnt/β-catenin is a developmental pathway hijacked by colorectal cancer. Normally a destruction complex keeps β-catenin low; losing APC lets it flood the nucleus and drive growth genes."
